objective: Every scenario must communicate its original actions, interactions and resolution using new artwork, with coherent contacts and timing. Stability and FPS alone do not establish completion.
acceptance: Identify original setup, action, reaction and ending for every scene and relevant branch.
Show the same causal action with appropriate new drawings and visible props; no generic unrelated pose substitutions.
Maintain object continuity and physical contacts; no disappearing required objects or duplicate composites.
Review dense action samples and full sequence telemetry, then native playback for the repaired scenarios.
Do not call any scenario passed merely because rendering completes or files validate.
